Actually, I already tried that sequence before. Let me think about what other sequences I haven't tried.
Wait, actually, I just realized something. The bars have 3 states: 5, 14, and 23 pixels. The toggle sequence is 5 -> 14 -> 23 -> 5 -> 14 -> 23 -> ...
So clicking on the U-shape or c cell toggles the bar to the next state in the sequence.

But that would just result in the bars being at (23, 23), which I already tried.
